description:
Current revision (user approved: "better implement this"): initial defaults are defined by provider clauses in the existing Zaq.ConnectorConfig.Settings.defaults/1, not application configuration. Remove the config block and configuration injection from pure settings helpers. Saved values still win; selective preservation and runtime fallback remain. Replace obsolete custom-config fixture coverage with module-owned defaults coverage; retain override/idempotence/removal assertions. This supersedes any configuration-entry requirements below. No new module, migration, adapter callback or MFA.

Implemented channel_settings_defaults config and Settings.defaults/merge/preserve. Engine create and confirmed-link/upsert insertion share defaults. Generic preservation retains only saved keys covered by each provider defaults template, avoiding accidental retention of unrelated deleted settings. Transport flags are adapter-validated. Dedicated WhatsAppSettings removed. Tests cover custom Telegram config with no provider branch, atom/string provider lookup, explicit values, retries and unchanged other providers.

The authoritative final ownership and delivery scope is in zaq-ho7. Historical dedicated-module/backfill requirements are superseded.

Required policies: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md;
docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md;
docs/services/channels.md. Read sibling AGENTS.md before sibling changes, Engine
guide before persistence work, and documentation hygiene before updating docs.
Read system-config guidance if touching encrypted fields (which should be avoided).
Preserve existing assertions. Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test
behavior; add focused tests first. No UI feature/E2E work is required by this refactor.
Commit, push, publishing dependency revisions, and merge require separate authorization.

comments.text: Implemented canonical ChannelConfig policy default/validation and pure Settings projection. Preserves explicit valid policy on replacement-style settings edits; other settings keep historical replacement semantics. Existing malformed non-WhatsApp jido_chat payloads remain accepted by existing contract; runtime reader handles them conservatively. Missing policy is default for other providers; WhatsApp gets mention_required; invalid explicit policy rejects. No encryption code changed. New property proves unrelated JSON preservation. mix q passes and 65 tests + 2 properties across policy/ChannelConfig/confirmation/settings pass. All pre-existing assertions preserved. No Actions or new dispatch paths.

Engine ChannelConfig.create/2 now applies WhatsAppSettings defaults before changeset/Repo insert; existing upsert insert and LinkedDeviceConfirmation use it. Shared changeset validates flags and preserves only saved history choices on replacement edits; direct changesets remain validation-only like widget. Defaults are deeply merged only along configured keys, explicit booleans preserved; null containers treated absent, explicit null/nonboolean flag rejected. Existing BO WhatsApp New flow enters authorized LinkedDeviceUI/confirmation rather than manual credential form; legacy generic BO persistence remains untouched. No new route/Action/tool or secret changes. mix q passes; 70 tests + 3 properties pass across settings, policy, schema, confirmation and projections. Existing tests unchanged. Logs /tmp/zaq-ho7-rework-zaq-{quality,settings-tests}.log.

title: [zaq-ho7.2] Persist shared provider defaults without dedicated settings modules
